description: Confirmed and unconfirmed balance of an address; with height or time, its confirmed balance at that point (for example at the end of a year).

height.description: Optional: the confirmed balance at the end of this block instead.

network.description: Network: BTC, LTC, DOGE, ZEC, BTCTEST, LTCTEST, DOGETEST or ZECTEST.

time.description: Optional: the confirmed balance at this time instead (a date means the end of that day): unix seconds, a date like 2025-12-31 (UTC) or a timestamp like 2025-12-31T23:59:59Z.

name: get_balance
title: Address Balance
